notes: HR reference data for Kenyan companies (docs/modules/hr.md HR-03, HR-12). Structure only: identifier types and statutory leave types. No figure is entered until it is confirmed from an official source: a null pattern enforces no format, and a null days value makes the leave type 'Days needed' (requests and accrual refused) until a tenant confirms it. Labels live in lang/{locale}/hr.php (pack.*).
todo: kra_pin: confirm the KRA PIN format (letter, 9 digits, letter) from KRA and its legal reference before enforcing a pattern.
national_id: confirm the national identity card number format (and the Maisha Namba / UPI format) before enforcing a pattern.
annual: statutory annual leave days and the qualifying service (Employment Act, 2007, s. 28), with the effective date.
maternity: statutory maternity leave days and pay (Employment Act, 2007, s. 29), with the effective date.
paternity: statutory paternity leave days (Employment Act, 2007, s. 29(8)), with the effective date.
sick: statutory sick leave days at full and at half pay and the qualifying service (Employment Act, 2007, s. 30).
Other leave (compassionate, pre-adoptive leave under s. 29A, study): confirm which are statutory and their days.
